targets.query:
from(bucket: "homeassistant")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "°C" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.entity_id =~ /^(pastry_shop_fridge_thread_probe_[12]|0x58e6c5fffe0f58b0_temperature_[34]|liebherr_brpsvh_6501_temperature)$/)
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with entity_id: if r.entity_id == "0x58e6c5fffe0f58b0_temperature_3" then "pastry_shop_fridge_thread_probe_2" else if r.entity_id == "0x58e6c5fffe0f58b0_temperature_4" then "pastry_shop_fridge_thread_probe_1" else r.entity_id}))
  |> group(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_measurement", "_field", "domain", "entity_id"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()
